independent_claim_checks.claim: K2 Insurance Services to close Aegis General's Executive Risks Division
independent_claim_checks.source_excerpt: K2 Insurance Services, a US insurance services provider, has confirmed that its subsidiary, Aegis General Insurance Agency, will discontinue operations within its Executive Risks Division as part of a wider review of its business portfolio. The company announced that the division will stop accepting new business and renewals from 1 November 2026. According to K2 Insurance Services, the decision was made following an assessment of the division’s alignment with the group’s wider business strategy.
